Malaya Malik is researching a public library system in a large metropolitan area where access to after-school programs varies by district. Malik claims that all districts of the metropolitan area should have more library branches offering free after-school tutoring, noting that the highest percentage of branches offering free after-school tutoring in any district is only ______
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the student's claim?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The table shows the percentage of library branches offering free after-school tutoring in each of five districts: Northgate (22%), Eastview (29%), Southridge (18%), Westhaven (15%), and Central (24%). The highest of these percentages is 29%, in Eastview, which effectively supports Malik's claim that the highest percentage of branches offering free after-school tutoring in any district is only 29%.
